mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO coupon_issue_request (stock_id, user_id, status, created_date, updated_date) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{userId}, #{status}, NOW(6), NOW(6))
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_id, user_id, status, coupon_id, reason, created_date, updated_date FROM coupon_issue_request WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_id = #{stockId}
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_issue_request SET status = 'ISSUED', coupon_id = #{couponId}, updated_date = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE coupon_issue_request SET status = 'REJECTED', reason = #{reason}, updated_date = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
